limitations: Viewport emulation and basic DOM checks only; no screen-reader audit, physical mobile wallet or signature/transaction was tested. The duplicate page was observed while its recent history was loading; its older creation/cancellation activity was independently verified through the actual frontend gateway in older-activity.json.
